newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Anaconda Nickel changes name, status.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Anaconda Nickel changes name, status.

text.p: Australian nickel explorer Anaconda Nickel Ltd, formerly Anaconda Nickel NL, said it changed its name and status on December 16.
The company lodged an Australian Securities Commission certificate registering the changes with the Australian Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
Anaconda changed its status to a company limited by shares from a no liability company.
The company is preparing to develop the Murrin Murrin nickel project in Western Australia.
